in_hebrew.name: רפאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רפאל הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים רפא' או 'אל רפא'. השם רפאל מורכב משתי מילים: 'רפא' שפירושה 'לרפא' ו'אל' שפירושה 'אלוהים'. השם נמצא בספרות היהודית והוא קשור לארכאנג'ל רפאל, המלאך המופיע בספרים שונים של התנך ובספרות היהודית.

in_greek.name: Ραφαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ραφαήλ είναι το όνομα που προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός Ραφαήλ' ή 'Ιατρός του Θεού'. Το όνομα Ραφαήλ αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'Ραφα' που σημαίνει 'γιατρός' και 'ήλ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το όνομα αυτό απαντάται στην Ιουδαϊκή γραμματεία και συνδέεται με τον Αρχάγγελο Ραφαήλ, ο οποίος εμφανίζεται σε διάφορα βιβλία της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης και της Ιουδαϊκής γραμματείας.

in_latin.name: Raphael
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Raphael originem habet in lingua Hebraea et significat 'Deus sanat' vel 'Deus est sanitas'. Nomen Raphael componitur ex duabus vocibus: 'Rapha' quod significat 'sanare' et 'El' quod significat 'Deus'. Nomen hoc invenitur in litteratura Judaica et connectitur cum Archangelo Raphaele, qui apparet in variis libris Veteris Testamenti et litteratura Judaica.

in_english.name: Rafael
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rafael originates from the Hebrew language and means 'God heals' or 'God is health'. Derived from the Hebrew words 'rapha' meaning 'to heal' and 'el' meaning 'God', Rafael is associated with the Archangel Raphael, a significant figure in Jewish, Christian, and Islamic traditions. The name symbolizes divine healing and protection, reflecting the Archangel's role as a healer and guardian.

biblical_reference.note: The Book of Tobit, part of the Apocrypha, features the Archangel Raphael as a healing angel.

saint_reference.note: In Catholic tradition, Raphael is considered a saint and one of the seven Archangels.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rafael is of Hebrew origin and has been popular in the Christian world for centuries. It is often associated with healing and divine graciousness due to its meaning, which likely contributed to its widespread adoption as a given name. Rafael is a common name in various Hispanic and Portuguese-speaking countries and can be found throughout history in art, literature, and music. In Spanish-speaking cultures, St. Raphael is recognized as a patron saint of travelers, doctors, and nurses.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rafael holds deep spiritual significance for Christians as it symbolizes God's healing power and His grace. It is a testament of faith and trust in the Almighty, reminding us that God, through His divine intervention, has the power to heal us from both physical and emotional ailments. For those named Rafael, it is an inspiring reminder of God's healing abilities and a call to become a source of healing and compassion to others.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Rafael, meaning "God heals" in Hebrew, symbolizes the divine power of healing and restoration. It is a reminder that even in times of suffering and pain, God's grace and mercy are always present to bring healing and new beginnings.
